d:
Strange noises, unexplained movements and chilling encounters can leave even seasoned investigators shaken. From moments of disbelief to reactions that say it all, watch the Ghost Adventures crew respond as paranormal situations take unexpected turns. When the unexplained happens right in front of them, how will they react?
Watch Ghost Adventures, S2, Episodes 4, 12, 10 & 1; S4, Episodes 6, 7 & 8; S3, Episodes 3 & 2; and S5, Episodes 10, 11 & 9 on Discovery Channel India.
